title: A cached bound is not an exact score
hook: A saved score may be an inequality rather than an answer.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Search trees; minimax and a partial solution state.
doesNotKnow: Reuse game-search transpositions only according to exact, lower-bound or upper-bound flags.

misconception: Every number cached by alpha-beta is the exact minimax value.
objective: Reuse game-search transpositions only according to exact, lower-bound or upper-bound flags.

claims.text: A lower-bound entry may raise alpha and justify a cutoff when it reaches beta. It is not an exact score. A wider window that remains open must search further; the stored bound alone cannot replace that unresolved work.
